design_archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Organic & Earthy

primary.name: Emerald Green
primary.description: Used for main actions, active states, and successful metrics.

background.name: Slate Background
background.description: App background. Keeps the UI neutral so schedules and data stand out.

surface.name: Card Surface
surface.description: For matrices, tables, and summary cards. Must have a subtle 1px border (#E2E8F0 in light, #1E293B in dark).

mono.description: Used for timeslots and room codes.

layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6. Summary cards at the top, followed by wide conflict resolution tables.
layouts.schedule_matrix: Interactive grid matrix using CSS Subgrid or strict fixed table layouts to ensure time slots align vertically and horizontally. Must allow horizontal scrolling on smaller screens.
layouts.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar for navigation on desktop, standard bottom nav or hamburger menu on mobile.
layouts.spacing: Dense inside tables (p-2 or p-3), but generous around containers (p-6 or p-8). Avoid cramming the outer edges.

components.cards: Flat solid surfaces. No heavy drop shadows. 1px solid border (border-slate-200/border-slate-800).
components.buttons: Slightly rounded corners (rounded-md). Solid Emerald for primary CTA, outline slate for secondary.
components.matrix_cells: Interactive cells should have subtle hover states (bg-slate-100/bg-slate-800) and clear focus rings (ring-2 ring-emerald-500).
components.conflict_alerts: Red left-border (border-l-4 border-red-500) on cards or cells containing a scheduling conflict. Highly visible.
components.drag_drop: Use @dnd-kit/core. While dragging, the element must scale up slightly (scale-105) and gain a drop shadow (shadow-lg) to indicate 'lift'.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on all buttons and table rows (bg-opacity changes).
motion.transitions: Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors duration-200 for backgrounds, transition-transform duration-200 for drag and drop). NEVER use 'transition-all'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on Emerald Green meets 4.5:1 ratio. If not, use a darker shade of Emerald for backgrounds containing text.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements (matrix cells, slots) must have a visible focus ring.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='auto-schedule-btn', data-testid='matrix-cell-monday-jp1').

login_background.description: Dark green subtle gradient background, perfect for the authentication page to establish the Islamic educational vibe without being cliché.

icons.usage: Use icons for sidebar navigation, conflict indicators (AlertTriangle), and status indicators (CheckCircle, XCircle).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Shadcn UI components are installed: Card, Button, Table, Badge, Tabs, Dialog, Form, Input, Select.
Install @dnd-kit/core, @dnd-kit/sortable, and @dnd-kit/utilities for the drag-and-drop schedule matrix.
Create a toggle mechanism (Available / Unavailable / Request) inside the Teacher Availability Matrix using custom Shadcn toggles or grouped buttons.
For the Schedule Builder matrix, use a sticky header for the time slots and a sticky first column for the days or classes, ensuring it remains navigable when heavily populated.

Implement real-time visual alerts (red highlights, badge counters) for conflicts. The Conflict Engine UI should explicitly explain the conflict (e.g., 'Teacher X double-booked' or 'Violates post-Dhuhr restriction').
Integrate printing/PDF export functionality via a library like react-to-print or window.print() styled with @media print.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for any dropdowns or dialogs. Always use a solid or highly opaque blurred background.
Prioritize optical alignment inside the schedule matrix.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition-all). Avoid generic center-align layouts. Prioritize left-alignment for data readability.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js or .tsx
